blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of the V31 front, seated, and crouched renders confirms a serious deformation failure: in the seated pose the forward skirt panels hang behind the raised thighs and leave the lap/shorts exposed; crouch coverage is better but the side panels break into pointed, intersecting strips. Pose-matched ray coverage records overskirt at 0.22 on both upper thighs in sit and 0.36/0.37 in crouch, while shorts are 0.95 in both.
V31 front and crouch renders still show coarse faceting, irregular folds, and uneven pointed panel edges. Surface/silhouette remain visibly unfinished.

Direct inspection of the current rear render shows no clearly readable adjustment-tab or buckle silhouette; neither element separates visually from the garment. The preview set also has no dedicated rear close-up.
The exact current weighted prototype still has no authored UV map. UV state remains MISSING; no substitute UV was generated.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
